description.narrative: The program, supported by a policy-based loan, is to improve the long-term fiscal sustainability of the RMI government. In 2010, the Asian Development Bank (ADB) approved (i) a program cluster for the public sector program, and (ii) financing from the Asian Development Fund (ADF) of $9.5 million (special drawing rights of 6,413,000) for subprogram 1 of the public sector program. The public sector program supports the implementation of the government's reform initiatives and initiates the adjustments required to achieve long-term fiscal sustainability. Under subprogram 1, policy actions were designed and the implementation of immediate reform priorities began. Subprogram 2 will complete the implementation of the policy actions.

Output: 1. Government's fiscal discipline improves over the medium term. Indicator: Ratio of current expenditure to GDP in FY2013 less than the FY2011 ratio (FY 2011 baseline: 51.6% of GDP, estimated).* Data Source: MOF annual budget statement
Output: 1. Government's fiscal discipline improves over the medium term. Indicator: Ratio of government debt to GDP in FY2013 less than the FY2011 ratio (FY 2011 Baseline: 60.3% of GDP, estimated)*

Output: 2. Cabinet enforces restraint on recurrent expenditure. Indicator: Ratio of wages and salaries to GDP in FY2013 less than the FY2011 ratio (FY 2011 baseline: 20.1% of GDP, estimated).* Data Source: MOF annual budget statement

Output: 3. Ministry of Finance increases tax revenue. Indicator: Ratio of tax revenue to GDP on track to reach 16.2% in FY2015 (FY 2011 baseline: 14.3% of GDP, estimated). Data Source: MOF annual budget statement

Output: 4. Selected state-owned enterprises improve their performance. Indicator: Positive consolidated rate of return on equity of SOEs by 2013 (2008 baseline: consolidated return on equity of -9.0%) Data Source: SOE annual financial reports

Output: 4. Selected state-owned enterprises improve their performance. Indicator: Ratio of subsidies to GDP in FY2013 less than the FY2011 ratio (FY 2011 Baseline: 3.0% of GDP, estimated)* Data Source: MOF annual budget statement

Output: 5. Cabinet ensures effective stakeholder participation in public sector reforms. Indicator: Development partners meeting held (Baseline: first development partners meeting held in December 2010, joint communiqué agreed to convene regular meetings to track progress toward implementation of the program).
* = A target of "less than" has been applied to allow the government in the overall policy mix to achieve the outcome statement. Data Source: Development partners meeting website

Output: 5. Cabinet ensures effective stakeholder participation in public sector reforms. Indicator: Three public consultation programs are attended by at least 20 stakeholders Data Source: Public consultation program activity report by MOF
